card.name: Numbers inside dose and result figures
card.fires_on: Digits, spaces or decimal points inside numeric values or ranges, often where a second number or a unit follows. Typical settings are radioactive doses in MBq and mCi, dose conversions, and tables of results.

modes.label: Dose ranges in parentheses
modes.description: The first digit of a converted range, such as mCi after MBq.

modes.label: Calculation results
modes.description: The gap before the answer in a worked multiplication.

modes.label: Table values
modes.description: A digit or space within paired mean and SD values.

card.plain: It fires on the middle of a number, such as a digit in a dose range or table, just before the rest of the figure.
